scope: execution compatibility only; no model, threshold, data, seed or confirmation-policy changes

reviewed_differences.src/lakematch/cli.py: Benchmark command dispatch; run/train/cluster retain their command contracts.
reviewed_differences.src/lakematch/config.py: Validation-selected defaults; DQX accepted. Full frozen configs override defaults.
reviewed_differences.src/lakematch/features.py: Remove unrelated global integration guard; feature expressions unchanged.
reviewed_differences.src/lakematch/quality/__init__.py: Lazy dispatcher selects the unchanged native implementation for frozen configs.
reviewed_differences.tools/frozen.py: Permit exactly this separately declared source snapshot for a measured compatibility replay.

reviewed_additions.src/lakematch/benchmark/campaign.py: Dispatch the explicit benchmark CLI into the repository runner.
reviewed_additions.src/lakematch/delta_publication.py: Job-only remote publication adapter; not imported by local frozen inference.
reviewed_additions.src/lakematch/murmur3.py: Native SQL hash adapter used only by declared serverless inference.
reviewed_additions.src/lakematch/native_ml.py: Exported SQL model adapter used only by declared serverless inference.
reviewed_additions.src/lakematch/quality/dqx.py: Optional lazy DQX adapter; frozen local configs select native quality.
reviewed_additions.src/lakematch/quality/rules.py: Shared seeded rules for the optional DQX adapter.
reviewed_additions.tools/benchmark_campaign.py: Bounded orchestration; retained failed scale tier blocks automatic repetition.
reviewed_additions.tools/cluster_sweep.py: Forward the explicit replay mode into sequential clustering experiments.
reviewed_additions.tools/compatibility.py: Hash-bound declaration, independent of the unchanged model freeze.
reviewed_additions.tools/report_cluster_replay.py: Independently audit exact clustering memberships and model identity.
reviewed_additions.tools/report_compatibility.py: Audit original versus replayed pairs, metadata, probabilities and decisions.
reviewed_additions.tools/run_clusters.py: Replay original clustering models, IDF and thresholds without refitting; compare edges and memberships.
reviewed_additions.tools/run_compatibility.py: Sequential replay with independent audit after each corpus.
reviewed_additions.tools/run_original_febrl.py: Exposed original-corpus diagnostic using the frozen model and gram baseline.
